close_reason: Opinion-tagged P4 by the bead author. The 'pass by value' signature reads as 'this transport is yours to consume; we're done with it' even though TransportConfig::build_client takes &self internally. Changing to &impl TransportConfig is a breaking change with no behavioural benefit. Won't fix; the existing shape is defensible.
description: src/client.rs:152 — `pub fn new(transport: impl TransportConfig, ...)`. clippy::pedantic flags 'this argument is passed by value, but not consumed in the function body' because TransportConfig::build_client takes &self. The current signature forces callers to pass an owned transport even though only a borrow is needed. Idiomatic alternative: `transport: &impl TransportConfig`. However: this is the documented public API, every caller already passes by value (`DefaultTransport`, `CustomCaTransport::new(der)`), and changing the signature is a breaking change. The transport is conceptually a one-shot factory consumed at construction even though the trait method takes &self — by-value reads as "this is yours to consume; we're done with it". Filing as opinion-tagged. Note: locked crate.
title: JmapClient::new takes transport: impl TransportConfig but never moves out of it
